findings_summary: Both publications are legitimate P022 observation-history replay evidence, but they are not byte-level or semantic duplicates. TP2-DE338F269CA11E9BC01B isolates the q=3r-1 Franel arithmetic-core boundary under P022_OBSERVATION_HISTORY_COMPLETION; TP2-D78DBA0243911E0363FA independently replays the forced-midpoint fallback q<6r-1 under P022_OBSERVATION_HISTORY_AND_COLLISION_GEOMETRY. The scopes are complementary surviving subfrontiers of the same legacy task id and neither should be erased.
